primarySources.section: Abstract and section10, Current Site Status and Site Operations
primarySources.facts: Residential buildings and other supporting infrastructure are complete and operational; summit telescope/enclosure foundations have been excavated but the operating enclosure remains unbuilt.

Technical SS1 lies roughly300m southwest of the summit; personnel SS2 roughly300m south of SS1. SS2 contains the staff/construction lodges, dining/kitchen and recreation buildings. These approximate relative descriptions locate the support cluster, not surveyed individual building identities.

inference: Original Google footprint cluster near[-70.687,-29.052] is spatially consistent with the published SS2 relationship. Individual exact functions,68/24room identity, floor counts, elevations and exterior details are not verified; use geographically descriptive building names.
excluded: The three2011OSMways136126248/136126273/136126275 aroundlatitude-29.027 are roughly2km north of GMT, not the southern personnel support site described here. They are not assigned to this project or used as proxies. No previous LasCampanas model reopened.
